messages.subject: runApp + List + dependsOnFile
parts:
I am not sure if this is a bug or expected, but here is the issue.

I am running a very simple Shiny app using runApp and a list with the ui and server. test.md can be any markdown file.

runApp(list(
  ui = includeMarkdown('test.md'),
  server = function(input, output){
    
  }
))

Now, if I run the app and then make changes to `test.md`, the ui is not updated. If I implement the same function using ui.R and server.R, then the updates do get reflected.

Is this expected behavior, or a bug?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: runApp + List + dependsOnFile
parts: It is unfortunate but expected. Using runApp with an object means the UI only gets rendered once, and no file changes are detected. We may have a workaround in the future but nothing today.

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: runApp + List + dependsOnFile
parts:
It works. Just so that anyone else wondering about this comes across this thread, this solution works

runApp(list(
  ui = uiOutput('mydoc'),
  server = function(input, output){
    output$mydoc <- renderUI({includeMarkdown('test.md')})
  }
))
